resolution_criteria: The number of US Senate seats held by Democrats and the independents who caucus with them once every 2026 Senate race, including any runoff, is decided, as a total. An answer given on air as D+N is stored as 47+N. Decided by the Associated Press's call. If AP has not called it within 60 days of election day, the certified official result decides. Resolves once every race that bears on the number has been called.
